content: Mʉtatɨnɨra abhiisirirya abhakɨndichanyu
Mwisiriryɨ umwisirirya ʉmʉkɨndichanyu wʉnʉ akɨɨrɨ kokongʼa mubhwisirirya bhwazɨ. Mʉtahakaana nawe igʉrʉ wa amiisɨɨgi gaazɨ.
Ʉmʉʉtʉ wu ubhwisirirya ʉbhʉnagu, ararora aratʉra kurya chʉchʉsi kirya, nawe wʉnʉ ubhwisirirya bhwazɨ bhʉkɨɨrɨ kokongʼa, ahaarya zinyinyi izeene.

Ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ akurya ibhyakurya bhyʉsi, atarega wʉnʉ akurya zinyinyi izeene. Nʉ ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ akurya zinyinyi izeene, wʉʉsi atatɨnɨra wʉnʉ akurya ibhyakurya bhyʉsi, kʉ kʉbha Mungu amwisiriiryɨ chɨmbu arɨ.

Awɨ ʉtaana ʉbhʉnaja bhwʉbhwʉsi bhwʉ ʉkʉtɨnɨra omohocha wʉ ʉwʉndɨ. Ʉmʉkʉrʉ waazɨ newe akʉtʉra komenya arɨɨbhɨ omohocha waazɨ asariryɨ hamwɨ atasariryɨ. No omohocha waazɨ arakora chɨmbu ikwenderwa, kʉ kʉbha Ʉmʉkʉrʉ Yɨɨsu anʉ ʉbhʉnaja bhu ukumwimiirirya kokorabhu.

Ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉmwɨ aratʉra korora urusikʉ ororebhe runu ubhwera kʉkɨra urusikʉ ʉrʉndɨ, nawe ʉmʉʉtʉ ʉwʉndɨ akarora zisikʉ zʉʉsi zituubhɨɨnɨ. Abhaatʉ bhʉʉsi bhabhɨ ne eheene igʉrʉ wa amangʼana ganʉ bhakwisirirya.

Ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ akorora urusikʉ ororebhe runu ubhwera kʉkɨra urusikʉ ʉrʉndɨ, arakorabhu kʉ kʉbha areenda kozomeerya Ʉmʉkʉrʉ Yɨɨsu. Na wʉnʉ akurya ibhyakurya bhyʉsi, arakorabhu ko kozomeerya Ʉmʉkʉrʉ Yɨɨsu, kʉ kʉbha akabhʉʉrɨra Mungu, “Ʉzʉmiryɨ.” Nʉ ʉwʉndɨ wʉnʉ atakurya, arakorabhu kʉ kʉbha areenda kozomeerya Ʉmʉkʉrʉ Yɨɨsu. Wuyo wʉʉsi akabhʉʉrɨra Mungu, “Ʉzʉmiryɨ.”
Nɨrabhugabhu, kʉ kʉbha atareeho ʉmʉʉtʉ gatɨ wɨɨtʉ wʉnʉ akwikara igʉrʉ waazɨ umwene, nʉʉrʉ wʉnʉ akukwa igʉrʉ waazɨ umwene.
Hanʉ tʉkʉbha bhahʉru, turiikara igʉrʉ wʉ Ʉmʉkʉrʉ Yɨɨsu, na hanʉ tukukwa, tʉrakwa igʉrʉ wʉ Ʉmʉkʉrʉ Yɨɨsu. Mmbe tʉraabhɨ bhahʉru hamwɨ turiikwɨ, itwɨ nɨ‑bhaatʉ bhaazɨ.
Kiriisitʉ akakwa na kuryʉka, korereke abhɨ Ʉmʉkʉrʉ wa abhaatʉ bhʉʉsi, abhaku na abhahʉru.
Nangʉ, ndora awɨ ʉratɨnɨra ʉmʉkɨndichazʉ? Kwakɨ na naawɨ ʉrarega ʉmʉkɨndichazʉ? Itwʉsi turiimɨɨrɨra mʉbhʉtangɨ bhwi ikitumbɨ cha Mungu chɨ ɨtɨnɨrʉ, na Mungu aratɨnɨra abhaatʉ bhʉʉsi.
Amaandɨkʉ Amarɨndu garabhuga,

content.text: abhaatʉ bhʉʉsi bhariisirirya kuminywa jabhʉ kʉbha inyɨ ni‑Mungu.”

content: Mmbe nɨmbu, itwʉsi tukwitonda itubheene mʉbhʉtangɨ bhwa Mungu.
Ʉtamwendeerya ʉmʉkɨndichazʉ
Nangʉ, tutigɨ kwitɨnɨra. Nawe tuhityɨ tʉtakora chʉchʉsi kɨnʉ kikwendeerya hamwɨ kugwisha ʉmʉkɨndichɨtʉ.
Ku kugwatana nʉ Ʉmʉkʉrʉ Yɨɨsu, nɨɨzɨ amaheene kʉbha, kɨtareeho ichakurya chʉchʉsi kibhuruuru kusimʉka yachʉ.
Nawe ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ areekerore ichakurya ni‑kibhuruuru, kwawe kɨrabha kibhuruuru.

Nʉ ʉmʉkɨndichazʉ araarumɨkɨ igʉrʉ wi ibhyakurya bhɨnʉ ukurya, hayo ʉtakʉbha ʉrakangatwa nʉ ʉbhʉsɨɨgi. Mmbe, utiisirirya ichakurya chazʉ kɨbhɨ kereetandeewa chu ukurimirya ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ Kiriisitʉ aakuurɨ igʉrʉ waazɨ!
Ʉtakora ekegero kɨnʉ awɨ okorora nɨ‑kɨzʉmu, nawe kʉbhandɨ kɨrarorekana nɨ‑kɨbhɨ.
Amangʼana gʉ ʉbhʉtɨmi bhwa Mungu
gatarɨ igʉrʉ wu kurya hamwɨ kunywa, nawe ni‑gʉrʉ we eheene, omorembe no obhozomerwa. Gayo gʉʉsi gahaatʉrɨkana kʉbhʉsakirya bhwe Ekoro Ɨndɨndu.
Ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉwʉʉsi wʉnʉ akohokerya Kiriisitʉ kʉmangʼana gayo, ahaazomera Mungu, na ahiisiriribhwa na abhaatʉ.
Nangʉ tugwatɨ ribhaga ryʉsi amangʼana ganʉ gakoreeta omorembe na gu ukwinaja mubhwisirirya bhwɨtʉ.
Ʉtasarya emeremo ja Mungu igʉrʉ wi ibhyakurya. Maheene, ibhyakurya bhyʉsi bhiriisiriribhwa kuriibhwa, nawe nɨ‑kɨbhɨ kʉmʉʉtʉ kurya ibhyakurya bhyʉbhyʉsi bhɨnʉ bhɨkʉtʉra kugwisha ʉmʉkɨndichazɨ.
Hakɨrɨku utigɨ kurya ɨnyama, hamwɨ kunywa idivaayi,
hamwɨ kokora chʉchʉsi kɨnʉ kɨkʉtʉra kugwisha ʉmʉkɨndichazʉ.
Nangʉ ubhwisirirya bhʉnʉ ʉnabhwɨ igʉrʉ wa amangʼana gayo, bhʉbhɨ gatɨ waazʉ na Mungu abheene. Hakɨrɨku ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ atakwitɨnɨra hanʉ akokora ekegero kɨnʉ akorora kɨrɨ bhwaheene.

Nawe ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ ana makɨbhwɨ igʉrʉ wi ibhyakurya bhɨnʉ akurya, aratinirwa na Mungu, kʉ kʉbha ʉmʉʉtʉ wuyo ariisirirya kʉbha kɨnʉ akʉrirɨ nɨ‑kɨbhɨ. Ʉmʉʉtʉ araakore chʉchʉsi kɨnʉ atakwisirirya kʉbha nɨ‑kɨbhɨ, arabha akʉrirɨ ʉbhʉbhɨ.

footnotes.text: Ʉbhʉtɨmi bhwa Mungu. Kʉmaragɨrɨra bhʉkʉngʼu, rora Ikiniibhasa.
